result.instructions: Tools for Ginesys, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Look up item K991067 and show its price and tax group."; "Create a sales order for 10 units of item K991067 for site 1001."; "Reserve 2 units of line 85279 on sales order 217810 at site 1.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ginesys data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ginesys_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ginesys_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ginesys_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ginesys_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ginesys_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by item code or barcode: division, department, category, vendor, prices (RSP, WSP, MRP, standard rate), tax group, unit of measure and stock settings. Ginesys GET /erp/gds/api/inv/item.

itemCode.description: Item code, for example K991067. Give this or barCode.

barCode.description: Item barcode. Give this or itemCode.

tools.name: ginesys_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create sales order
tools.description: Create a sales order with its item lines in Ginesys ERP (POST /erp/gds/api/sales-order). Set intgOrderId to your own order id: Ginesys rejects a second order with the same id, so a retry cannot create a duplicate. Only itemDetails is required by this tool; the API returns a field error for any other field it needs.

destinationSiteCode.description: Destination site, for a transfer order.

intgOrderId.description: Your own order id. Must be unique in the ERP.

reservationRequired.description: Y reserves stock when the order is created.

intgOrderDetailId.description: Your own id for this order line.

channelB2COrderDetId.description: Your web shop's id for this order line, if any.

tools.name: ginesys_create_reservation
tools.title: Reserve order stock
tools.description: Reserve stock for lines of an existing sales order at a site (POST /erp/gds/api/reservation). Give erpOrderCode or intgOrderId to find the order.

requestId.description: Your request id, a UUID as in the vendor examples. Default: a new UUID.

transactionSiteCode.description: Site that holds the stock to reserve.

erpOrderCode.description: ERP code of the sales order.

intgOrderId.description: Your own order id, if the order has one.

reservePartially.description: Y reserves what is available instead of the full quantity.

erpOrderDetCode.description: ERP code of the sales order line.

intgOrderDetId.description: Your own id for the order line, if it has one.

createReservationDetails.description: Order lines to reserve. At least one.

tools.name: ginesys_cancel_reservation
tools.title: Cancel order reservation
tools.description: Cancel part or all of a stock reservation on sales order lines (DELETE /erp/gds/api/reservation). Give erpOrderCode or intgOrderId to find the order.

requestId.description: Your request id, a UUID as in the vendor examples. Default: a new UUID.

erpOrderCode.description: ERP code of the sales order.

intgOrderId.description: Your own order id, if the order has one.

erpOrderDetCode.description: ERP code of the sales order line.

intgOrderDetId.description: Your own id for the order line, if it has one.

cancelQty.description: Quantity to cancel. Cannot exceed the quantity still open to cancel.

orderDetails.description: Order lines to cancel. At least one.
